The '''3rd Brigade''' was a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The 3rd Brigade's [[Hawkbat Battalion]] fought in numerous engagements at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. The [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] was originally led by various [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] including [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

==Description==
The 3rd Brigade was a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The brigade's subordinate unit, the [[Hawkbat Battalion]],<ref name="GentleGiant" /> was also part of the [[101st Regiment]].<ref name="IC 84">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

==History==
The 3rd Brigade's [[Hawk-bat/Legends|Hawkbat]] Battalion fought in numerous battles early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GentleGiant" /> Such battles included the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="IC 84" /> which marked the start of the pan-[[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]],<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> as well as a subsequent [[Battle of unidentified rainy planet|engagement]] in a [[Water/Legends|rainy]] [[Unidentified rainy planet (Clone Wars)|terrestrial object]].<ref name="GentleGiant" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Development===
The 3rd Brigade first appeared in "[[Chapter 1 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 1]]" of the micro-animated television series ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' that released on [[November 7]], [[2003]]<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> through its sub-unit, Hawkbat Battalion. The parent organization was identified in the [[2019]] bust for a Hawkbat Battalion character from [[Gentle Giant Studios]].<ref name="GentleGiant" />

===Contradiction===
"[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," a [[2005]] reference article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]], establishes that the [[7th Legion]] was Hawkbat Battalion's parent organization, itself containing the 101st [[Regiment/Legends|Regiment]] to which Hawkbat belongs to.<ref name="IC 84" /> This contradicts the Gentle Giant bust,<ref name="GentleGiant" /> as brigades and [[Legion/Legends|legions]] are established to be the same [[Army/Legends|military]] formation in both ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guide]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]],<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and "Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic."<ref name="IC 84" /> Therefore, it is structurally impossible for the 3rd Brigade and the 7th Legion to both contain Hawkbat Battalion as part of the same [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]]. As such, this article assumes that the 3rd Brigade and 101st Regiment held joint command over the Hawkbat Battalion, without the 3rd Brigade belonging to the 7th Legion's Order of Battle.<ref name="IC 84" />
